cards.title: Request the Sunrise Transition

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Waldron Tower, <callsign>, would like to put a Sunrise on request.

exchange.speaker: Tower
exchange.text: <callsign>, Waldron Tower, Sunrise Transition is approved, at Point Chapman contact Cabaniss Tower.

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: <callsign>, Sunrise Transition approved, at Point Chapman contact Cabaniss Tower.

cards.note: The readback is written in the same pattern as the other approvals. Check with an instructor.
cards.source: Binder, p. 26; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slides 80–84.
